findings.evidence: Mobile header shows Gravicentra Insurance instead of configured tenant brand/logo.
findings.rootCause: base.css hides .tb-logo at max-width:880px while public-tenant-branding renders tenant logo into .tb-logo; product brand remains visible.
findings.requiredProof: On mobile and desktop, tenant brand/logo is visible according to approved shell hierarchy without losing Gravicentra product identity where applicable.

findings.evidence: Cliente 360 mobile list exposes filters but no free-text search.
findings.rootCause: Cliente360 list search reuses .tb-search; global mobile CSS hides .tb-search at max-width:980px.
findings.requiredProof: Cliente360 free-text search remains visible and usable on mobile and desktop, without changing topbar mobile-search behavior.

findings.evidence: Cliente360 Renewals tab overflows horizontally and content/actions are clipped on mobile.
findings.rootCause: tabRenov renders fixed-width flex children (120px + flexible bar + 150px + badge + button) without a mobile wrap/grid contract.
findings.requiredProof: Renewal row and actions fit mobile viewport with no clipped business information or action.

findings.evidence: Management requested from Cliente360/Renewals does not use the same complete Ops management editor.
findings.rootCause: Orbit.ciclo.solicitarGestion uses a separate request modal while Ops +Gestión creates a generic record and then opens openGestion; creation semantics/UI are split.
findings.requiredProof: Cliente360, Policy, Renewals, Portal and Ops all open one canonical management creation/editor surface with contextual prefill and create one canonical gestion record.

findings.evidence: Management request UI offers file attachment.
findings.rootCause: solicitarGestion explicitly stores only file name/size in adjuntos and does not persist binary/document repository reference.
findings.requiredProof: Attached support is durably stored in the approved documentary repository, linked by metadata/provenance to the gestion, opens after reload, and does not expose a false upload success.

findings.evidence: User requires ability to remove an erroneously created management; current management detail exposes archive but no delete/remove action.
findings.rootCause: openGestion actions include resolve/reopen/client/archive, with no authorized remove path.
findings.requiredProof: Authorized user can remove an erroneous management from active Ops with confirmation, audit/tombstone semantics and canonical readback; no silent orphaned relations.

findings.evidence: A renewable policy expiring within the already-used renewal window lacks an active Renew action on policy detail.
findings.rootCause: Canonical 0–45 day renewal criterion exists in CRM/policies list, but policy full-detail owner does not expose equivalent renewal entrypoint.
findings.requiredProof: Renewable policies at 0–45 days show the canonical renewal action on policy detail; outside-window/non-renewable behavior is explicit and consistent.

findings.evidence: Policy detail offers three vehicle candidates that visually represent the same vehicle/history.
findings.rootCause: policy-receipts-v1199-detail-guard vehicleCandidates deduplicates only by raw record id; historical/lineage-equivalent records with normalized same plate remain separate candidates.
findings.requiredProof: Linker shows one canonical current vehicle per normalized identity/lineage with prior vigencies preserved as history; no reimport.

findings.evidence: Cliente360 offers Importar a este expediente and documentary mode claims files are stored/visible.
findings.rootCause: importa.js documentary path advances directly to completion and performs no durable raw-file storage write; intelligent mode extracts data but does not retain the raw document.
findings.requiredProof: Client document upload stores the raw file in the approved documentary repository (Drive), records durable link/provenance in the client expediente, survives reload, and remains distinct from data extraction proposals.
